## MechWarrior 1 Remake 1.1.2

Fixes.

- **The enemies on the two ice maps no longer stand still.** They were asleep until you came within about 650 m; they patrol, and come for you, from the start.
- **In battles and defences every enemy comes for you, as in MechWarrior (1989):** an enemy whose own patrol can't bring it near now comes from any distance. A few still stop short, pushing against ground they can't cross: on the two ice maps and one other.
- In a defence on one map (MW3's C3, third contract map) an enemy used to wait on a hilltop the whole mission. It comes down now.

Reach and attack contracts keep their maps' own patrols.

Saved games are unchanged: 1.1.2 reads and writes the same saves as 1.1.1.

You still need your own copies of MechWarrior (1989), MechWarrior 3 and Pirate's Moon.
